confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on 2026-dated aggregate guides (Cities Insider, Combien-coute citing Numbeo) plus older Expatistan data, so they are medium quality. Cocktail is medium-low. Wine by the glass is low confidence: no Chengdu by-glass price was found, so it is estimated from beer and bottle-price relationships. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. The sources are not dated to July 2026, and July is peak summer, so accommodation may run higher than the estimates. FX: the 0.6955 value for 2026-10-15 was reported in a search summary attributed to the RBA, but I did not confirm it on the RBA page itself, so verify it there before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against other mainland Chinese provincial capitals and large second-tier cities with similar restaurant and hotel levels. Restaurant and drink anchors use Chengdu-specific aggregate guides. Accommodation uses general knowledge of comparable Chinese cities, not any inspected listing.
